## Brand Strategy
- **Who We Are:** The global agreements platform.
- **What We Do:** Turn static documents into living, breathing agreements that guide life and business.
- **How We Do It:** The common ground where the world comes together to agree.
- **Why We Do It:** "Relationships start with agreements. And agreements start with Docusign."
- **Brand Promise:** "Bringing Agreements to Life."
- **Creative Platform:** "Dynamic Connection" -- two visual principles: Connection (intersecting shapes, things coming together) and Dynamism (dimensionality, growth, transformation, collaboration).
- **New category:** Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) -- positioning Docusign as category creator beyond eSignature.
- **Name change:** "DocuSign" (camel-case) changed to "Docusign" as of April 11, 2024.

## Logo
- **Primary mark:** Nexus icon + "Docusign" wordmark. Two shapes (a block and a "D" monogram) converge to form the "shape of agreements" (dog-eared document with 45-degree fold) in the center.
- **Configurations:** Horizontal (preferred) and vertical (sparingly, for centered layouts or limited horizontal space).
- **Clear space:** Horizontal = width of Nexus icon. Vertical = width of one Nexus shape.
- **Minimum size:** 52px / 0.75" wide.
- **Light theme:** Nexus in Cobalt/Poppy, center and wordmark in black (on white/ecru backgrounds).
- **Dark theme:** Nexus in Cobalt/Poppy, center and wordmark in white (on Inkwell backgrounds).
- **One-color version:** White or black (on photos, gradients, textures, limited-color printing, embroidery, manufacturing).
- **IAM lockup:** "Docusign IAM" for specific platform story moments and sales pitch decks.
- **Tagline lockup:** Horizontal logo + "Bringing Agreements to Life." Minimum 180px / 2.5" wide.
- **Co-branding:** Rule divider between logos, baseline-aligned or center-stacked.
- **Misuse rules:** No stretching, no icon/wordmark separation, no rotation, no repositioning, no shadows, no strokes.
- **Trademark guidelines:** Comprehensive legal usage guidelines for word marks.

## Typography
- **Primary typeface:** DS Indigo -- custom bespoke typeface. "Happy medium between classic grotesque and geometric sans." Modern and digital but not stuffy. Six weights: Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold, plus wordmark variant.
- **Weight usage:**
  - Headlines/Titles: DS Indigo Light
  - Subheadlines: DS Indigo Regular or Semibold
  - Body text: DS Indigo Medium or Regular
- **Hierarchy system:** x-height based. Subheadlines set no larger than x-height of headline; body copy at ~50% of subheadline cap height.
- **Styling:**
  - Alignment: Left (primary); center sparingly for display/ads.
  - Tracking: -2% (display), -1% (subheadlines), 0%/auto (body).
  - Leading: 90-105% (display), 120% (subheadlines), 150% (short-form body), 175% (long-form body).
- **Line length:** 50-75 characters for body text.
- **Color in typography:** Full accessibility matrix for text on Cobalt, Deep Violet, Inkwell, White, Ecru, Mist backgrounds.
- **System fallbacks:** Documented for non-brand-font contexts.

## Color
- **Brand palette:**
  - Cobalt: #4C00FF / CMYK 88.79.0.0 / Pantone 2368 -- primary, iconic brand color
  - Inkwell: #130032 / CMYK 94.93.0.79 / Pantone 276 -- dark theme background
  - Deep Violet: #26065D / CMYK 99.98.0.35 / Pantone 2755
  - Mist: #CBC2FF / CMYK 36.32.0.0 / Pantone 2705 -- light accent
  - Poppy (brand red): #FF5252 / CMYK 0.93.82.0 / Pantone 1788 -- used sparingly as accent, primarily as stroke/outline rather than fill
  - White: #FFFFFF
  - Ecru: warm neutral
- **Usage and ratios:** 2-color, 3-color, and 4-color balance compositions documented. Poppy described as "the exclamation mark on a page."
- **Accessibility:** All text/background combinations documented for large text accessibility pass.
- **Gradients:** Documented gradient system.
- **Light/dark themes:** Defined background, text, and accent color assignments for each.

## Graphics
- **The Shape of Agreements:** Dog-eared document shape (45-degree fold) as core visual device. Used as standalone geometric element.
- **Geometry:** Intersecting shapes representing agreements coming together.
- **Pictograms:** Custom pictogram system.
- **Illustrations:** Custom illustration style.
- **Glassmorphism:** Frosted glass effect incorporated into visual language.
- **Intersections:** Overlapping geometric shapes as brand motif.
- **Data visualization:** Documented system.
- **Containers and overlays:** Framework for image/text relationships.

## Tone of Voice
- **Writing guidelines:** Documented as a section (page 12) but text content not fully extracted. Brand language emphasizes "frontierism, adventure, moving fearlessly into the next chapter." Direct, confident, aspirational.
- **Terminology:** Specific vocabulary around "agreements" (not "contracts" or "documents"), "bringing to life" (not "digitizing").

## Outliers
- Full rebrand simultaneous with category creation (eSignature to IAM) -- rare strategic coupling of brand and business transformation.
- Corporate name spelling change (DocuSign to Docusign) documented within the brand guidelines themselves.
- "Shape of Agreements" (dog-eared document) as a core geometric motif that permeates the entire system from logo to graphic elements.
- Nexus icon embeds three meanings: convergence of two shapes, formation of agreement shape in negative space, and the "D" monogram.
- DS Indigo typeface uses Light weight for headlines (counter to convention of heavy weights for display) -- creating an elegant, modern hierarchy.
- Glassmorphism as a documented brand technique is contemporary and unusual for enterprise SaaS guidelines.
- Poppy red restricted to stroke/outline rather than fill -- highly specific usage constraint.
- 157MB file size indicates extremely high-fidelity visual content.
- Product imagery guidelines (hi-fi vs. simplified interfaces) show sophisticated thinking about representing software visually.

## Quality Score
**5 / 5** -- A comprehensive, modern brand identity system documenting a major rebrand and category creation. Covers every aspect from brand strategy through visual identity, typography, color (with accessibility), photography, video/motion, product imagery, and writing guidelines in 102 pages. The custom typeface (DS Indigo), Nexus icon system, shape of agreements motif, and glassmorphism approach demonstrate sophisticated design thinking. The strategic integration of brand promise into visual execution (Dynamic Connection) is exceptionally well-articulated.
